annotation.title_clean: Recomendaciones para una inteligencia artificial fiable
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Subsecretaría de Tecnologías de la Información, Jefatura de Gabinete de Ministros (Argentina)
annotation.venue: Boletín Oficial de la República Argentina (Anexo I, Disposición 2/2023)
named_instruments_referenced: UNESCO Recommendation on the Ethics of AI
annotation.summary_en: Argentine Undersecretariat of IT guidance manual for public-sector AI projects. It sets UNESCO and OECD-based ethical principles across the AI lifecycle (design, validation, implementation, operation), stressing human responsibility, traceability, auditability, bias control, premortem risk analysis and human service channels. It has no robotics-specific content.
key_provisions_or_claims: AI is a tool: execution may be delegated but responsibility always stays with humans.
Project teams should be diverse and multidisciplinary, and sign a formal ethical commitment.
Lifecycle ethics checks cover data design, model validation, implementation and operation, with risk classification against UNESCO principles.
Traceability, auditing, logging and information security are required in deployment.
A human, in-person service channel must always be available for people who cannot or prefer not to use AI services.
